evals.expected_output: A findings report that flags ContactsController.list as an unbounded list returning a bare array, flags TagsController.list for a different list envelope and its own 0-indexed page and limit declaration, flags the bare :id route on contacts, says no documented convention was found so the stated defaults were used, and proposes concrete fixes.
assertions: Flags ContactsController.list (src/contacts/contacts.controller.ts) as returning every row as a bare array with no server-side bound and no pagination

Flags the tags list as using a different envelope (items and nextPage) from a paginated list that carries the rows and a total count, and as declaring its own page and limit parameters inside the controller
Flags the 0-indexed page default on the tags list as a problem, since pages are 1-indexed by default
Flags the bare :id route on contacts and proposes a resource-named parameter such as :contact_id
States that no API convention is documented in the repo and that the findings use the stated defaults, instead of presenting the defaults as the team's rules
Uses the skill's report structure: numbered, severity-tagged findings that cite the file and handler, each with a concrete fix

evals.expected_output: A findings report that does not flag the bounded, commented countries selector or the /auth/login route, and reports the repeated validation in ProductsService.create as a boundary violation: the checks duplicate what the DTO and ValidationPipe already do, in a layer that should trust its input. The report names docs/api.md as the source of the convention it applied.
assertions: Does not flag the countries selector as an unbounded list, since it carries a hard take bound and a comment naming the bound and why it is a selector - restraint / false-positive check
Does not flag POST /auth/login for being off the resource route pattern, since auth routes are exempt - restraint / false-positive check
Flags the manual name and price checks in ProductsService.create (src/products/products.service.ts) as validation repeated behind the HTTP boundary, where the DTO and ValidationPipe already validate
Proposes removing the duplicate checks from the service and putting any missing rule (such as the price minimum) on CreateProductDto
Names docs/api.md as the source for the list, auth-route and selector rules it applied, instead of presenting its own defaults as the team's rules
Assigns a severity to the finding and uses the skill's numbered report structure

evals.expected_output: A findings report that reports the bare :id route as an API shape problem, accepts the list envelope as matching the documented convention, and hands the query-per-order loop to the check-query-safety skill instead of judging it, with a one-line pointer.
assertions: Flags the bare :id route on OrdersController.get (src/orders/orders.controller.ts) and proposes a resource-named parameter such as :order_id
Does not flag the list envelope, since it matches the documented data and meta shape - restraint / false-positive check
The one-query-per-order loop appears only under 'Handed off' as a single line pointing to the check-query-safety skill, with no severity and no fix of its own
Reports the direct customer query in the controller (this.db.customer.findUnique) as data access in the HTTP layer, a shape finding, while its N+1 cost is the part that is handed off
Does not report missing authentication or ownership checks as findings of its own; if it mentions them, it points to the review-auth skill
